notablePrerequisites:
Triton Cavalry does not have summoning sickness.
Leyline Immersion attached to Triton Cavalry.
description:
Activate Triton Cavalry by tapping it, adding {3}{G}{G} that can only be spent to cast spells.
Cast Instill Energy by paying {G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Leyline Immersion to your hand from the battlefield.
Activate Instill Energy by paying {0}, untapping Triton Cavalry.
Cast Leyline Immersion by paying {3}{G}, targeting Triton Cavalry.
Triton Cavalry triggers, returning Instill Energy to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
